description: Defines a Flutter StatefulWidget 'HistoryPage' that displays a list of completed sessions with timestamps, allowing users to view historical focus/break sessions and clear the history.

classes.name: HistoryPage
classes.description: A Flutter widget that shows a list of past focus and break sessions, with functionality to clear history.

classes.name: _HistoryPageState
classes.description: State class for 'HistoryPage' managing UI build, data loading, and user interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers loading of sessions when the widget is first created.

methods.description: Builds the UI, showing either a message if no sessions exist or a list of sessions with details.
